name: CAXiE Sentinel
tagline: Security monitoring dashboard for Nigerian SMEs
description: A lightweight, cloud-hosted security monitoring dashboard purpose-built for Nigerian small and medium enterprises. Sentinel aggregates alerts from your endpoints, network devices, and cloud services into a single unified view — without the enterprise price tag. Designed for organisations that need visibility but don't have a dedicated SOC.
features: Unified alert dashboard across endpoints, network, and cloud
NDPR-aligned incident logging and audit trail
targetAudience: Nigerian SMEs, clinics, schools, and NGOs needing affordable security visibility

name: DataBridge
tagline: One-click data pipeline for African business data sources
description: DataBridge is a no-code data integration tool designed specifically for the African business environment — connecting paystack transactions, ERP exports, Google Sheets, and local POS systems into a unified analytics layer. Think Zapier for data, built around the realities of Nigerian business operations.
features: Native connectors for Paystack, Flutterwave, and local POS systems
Google Sheets and Excel import with schema auto-detection
Role-based access — your accountant sees revenue, your ops lead sees logistics
Export to Power BI, Looker, or CSV
targetAudience: SMEs and mid-market companies wanting BI without a data team

name: SiteGuard
tagline: Automated web security scanner for Nigerian businesses
description: SiteGuard runs automated weekly scans of your website for known vulnerabilities, SSL issues, exposed credentials, and outdated dependencies — then sends a plain-English report with actionable remediation steps. No security background required to understand the output.
features: Weekly automated scans with plain-English results
WhatsApp delivery of weekly security digest
targetAudience: Any Nigerian business with a web presence that can't afford a full security retainer
